notes: The page gives no age or grade rule beyond secondary school, and it lists no election dates.
name: Massachusetts State Student Advisory Council
org: Massachusetts Department of Elementary and Secondary Education
what_you_do: Be a student voice on education in Massachusetts. Regional councils elect delegates to a state council that advises the Board of Education. The elected chair is a full voting member of the Board.
who_can_apply: Secondary school students at a Massachusetts school. Every secondary school can elect two representatives to its regional council, so you run for election at your school.
pay_detail: Not stated. A leadership role, not a job.
deadline_text: The page lists no election dates. Ask your school about its election.
how_to_apply: Ask your school about its Student Advisory Council election. The DESE page has an Elections link with the recommended procedure.
